title: Embeddings & Rerank Quickstart — hero assets and stepwise flow visuals
creator: Ava Chen
description: Design and produce a compact set of onboarding visuals for the Embeddings + Rerank quickstart that ship with the 2026.03 console release. Deliverables include a hero illustration for the quickstart landing, a clear pipeline diagram (two variants: developer-focused and product-focused), annotated sample output cards (text + score + progression of rerank), and 3 responsive screenshots for docs and in-console carousel. Visuals should emphasize the pipeline: embed -> index -> query -> rerank -> serve and make cost/latency tradeoffs explicit in the product-focused diagram.
assets_needed: Hero banner illustration (1280x480) — developer + product variations
Pipeline diagram - developer view (SVG) showing code snippets and data flow
Pipeline diagram - product view (SVG) showing metrics: latency, cost, recall
Annotated sample output card set (3 cards) showing original results, relevance scores, reranked results
Docs carousel screenshots: quickstart step 1 (embed call), step 2 (indexing), step 3 (query+ranks)
Console in-context screenshot with highlighted 'Try it' button and sample response
Mobile-optimized thumbnail set for doc index and email promo
Figma prototype with interactive hover states for pipeline nodes
Alt text and short captions for all assets
acceptance_criteria: Hero banner approved by PM and Content (visual and copy)
Both pipeline diagrams exported as accessible SVGs and PDF printables
Sample output cards include human-readable explanation of score and rerank step
Three docs/screenshots exported at required resolutions (desktop, tablet, mobile) and uploaded to Drive
Assets wired to docs markdown with correct import links and image captions
Design tokens and colors use approved Redwood palette and pass contrast checks
notes_and_decisions: Use simplified iconography for model and index to avoid implying a specific vendor
Product-focused diagram will include small callouts for 'cost per 1k queries' and 'median latency' — numbers will be placeholders until ENG provides telemetry
We will prefer inline code screenshots over long multiline snippets to keep hero clean
Decided against animated SVG for initial release to reduce engineering lift — reserve animation for next minor release
Accessibility: add text-only linear flow beneath each diagram for screen readers
